title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List
statement:
Given the head of a sorted linked list (represented as an array of values), delete all duplicates such that each element appears only once. Return the linked list sorted as well.

You can perform this directly on the array or iteratively build the result.
constraints:
0 <= N <= 10^5
-10^9 <= A[i] <= 10^9
The list is guaranteed to be sorted in ascending order.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing the sorted values.
outputFormat: Space-separated integers: the list with duplicates removed.
